Name: MissCoriel's Supplement Pack 2 Songs of the Sand
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
This supplemental pack carries 3 songs to replace the Calico Desert Theme.  Each was handcrafted to give a desert feel.

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Listen to the music pack here![/b][/size][/color]
[soundcloud]https://soundcloud.com/evilpickle-music-dept/sets/sounds-of-sand[/soundcloud]

Instructions are like other music packs.  
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music by Platonymous[/url]﻿
[*]Place this mod in the Mods Folder
[/list]
If there is freezing issues [b]Check the config.json in Custom Music.  Set Covert to false if it says true.[/b]
